title: 3dSeg
description: Segments brain volumes into tissue classes with optional global and voxelwise priors.

mask.description: Mask of the volume to be segmented. Can be a dataset or 'AUTO' to use AFNI's automask function.
mask.title: Mask

blur_meth.description: Blurring method for bias field estimation. Options: BFT, BIM, BNN, LSB. Default: BFT
blur_meth.title: Blurring Method

bias_fwhm.description: The amount of blurring used when estimating the field bias. Default: 25.0
bias_fwhm.title: Bias FWHM

classes.description: String of class labels separated by semicolons. Default: 'CSF; GM; WM'
classes.title: Classes

Bmrf.description: Weighting factor controlling spatial homogeneity of classifications. Default: 0.0
Bmrf.title: MRF Weighting Factor

bias_classes.description: Classes that contribute to the estimation of the bias field. Default: 'GM; WM'
bias_classes.title: Bias Classes

overwrite.description: Automatically overwrite existing files with the same prefix.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

mixfrac.description: Volume-wide mixing fractions for initialization. Options: '0.1 0.45 0.45', 'UNI', 'AVG152_BRAIN_MASK', 'IGNORE'. Default: UNI
mixfrac.title: Mixing Fraction

mixfloor.description: Set the minimum value for any class's mixing fraction. Default: 0.0001
mixfloor.title: Mixing Fraction Floor

main_N.description: Number of iterations to perform. Default: 5
main_N.title: Number of Iterations

cset.description: Initial classification. Uses 3dkmean's engine if not provided.
cset.title: Initial Classification Set

labeltable.description: Label table containing integer keys and corresponding labels.
labeltable.title: Label Table

vox_debug.description: 1D index of voxel to debug or 3D voxel indices.
vox_debug.title: Voxel Debug Index

vox_debug_file.description: File in which debug information is output, use '-' for stdout, '+' for stderr.
vox_debug_file.title: Debug Information Output File
